description.en: Said once, to a member's first topic. {username} becomes their name. Leave blank and each newcomer is greeted in the language they read the site in.
description.zh_CN: 对成员的第一个主题说一次。{username} 会替换成他们的用户名。留空则按每个新人自己的界面语言问候。

description.en: Keep the greeting at the top of the member's topic, above every other reply.
description.zh_CN: 把欢迎回复置顶在该主题的所有回复上方。

description.en: Nobody can reply under the greeting itself; the rest of the topic is untouched.
description.zh_CN: 欢迎回复本身不允许被回复，主题的其余部分不受影响。
